So Lord, in belonging to you, may we live like it.
Give us the power to change, to make even just a small step forward today and this week.
Lord, we will need your grace.
Our attempts at self-improvement, our resolutions will always fail.
But Lord, we pray that You would sustain us and teach us by Your grace.
We pray all these things in Jesus' name. Amen.
